data_artifact.extraction_method: Direct transcription of Table 2, followed by visual verification against the publisher PDF.

statistical_reporting.reason: Table 2 reports mean plus-or-minus values but does not define the plus-or-minus statistic.

experiment.measurement_method: A vertical soil cross-section was excavated and the visible wetted width and depth were measured with a tape.

geometry.faloye_reference_geometry: A three-dimensional surface point source produces a wetting bulb; an axisymmetric r-z wetting body is the natural reduced modeling approximation.
geometry.faloye_observation_geometry: A two-dimensional vertical excavation through the three-dimensional wetted body records horizontal width and vertical depth.
geometry.emitter_position: At the soil surface at a point-source drip outlet; exact x-y coordinates, outlet radius, and wetted footprint are not reported.

hutd06_geometry.source_representation: line source per unit out-of-plane length

flow_rate_mapping.paper_input_unit: L h-1 per physical point emitter
flow_rate_mapping.hutd06_required_basis: water input per unit out-of-plane line length
flow_rate_mapping.reason: A point-emitter discharge cannot be mapped to a KAT=2 Cartesian line source without an explicit and justified representative emitter-row length or periodic emitter spacing. The paper's 30 cm spacing is evidence, not an automatic model mapping.

missing_for_richards_solver_reproduction: hardpan hydraulic retention and conductivity parameters
emitter outlet radius or wetted footprint
lateral and lower hydraulic boundary conditions
known_source_inconsistencies: The text gives particle density as 2.56 g cm-3, while the tabulated porosities are closer to values calculated with 2.65 g cm-3.
The Table 1 15-30 cm bulk-density row is labeled DD30cm, likely a typographical error.
Porosity means are reported as percentages while their STD values appear to use a fractional scale.
The methods list irrigation times through 120 min but also state that operation continued until 180 min; Table 3 uses 180 min.
The claimed optimum of 225 cm3 at 0.12 L h-1 for 75 min violates volume conservation; that rate and duration equal 150 cm3.
The Figure 2 depth curves are not numerically consistent with the Table 2 depth values.

allowed_uses: order-of-magnitude diagnostics after an explicit geometry mapping
forbidden_uses: direct comparison of L h-1 point-emitter discharge with a KAT=2 line-source input
claim of independent Richards-equation solver validation
treating reported_spread as a confirmed standard deviation
